name: sse-client
description: Universal Server-Sent Events (SSE) client built on standard Fetch and Streams API. Supports custom headers, request options, and auto-reconnections.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when subscribing to server-sent events (SSE) or event streams (like AI completion text streams, live dashboards, or stock updates) while requiring custom authorization headers or custom HTTP options.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Optional configuration including headers, method, body, and custom reconnect settings.
